description.name: Entry
description.text: Causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)], grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (8s)] to all allies, grants [Awoken Moonshade Butterfly], [Troupe Mayakov Mode (Support, Dancer)] and [Troupe Mayakov Mode (Celerity)] to the user

description.name: Awoken Moonshade Butterfly
description.text: Support, Celerity and Dancer abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Support, Celerity and Dancer abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies after using Support, Celerity and Dancer abilities

description.name: Troupe Mayakov Mode (Support, Dancer)
description.text: Grants/causes [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (8s)]/[DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)] to all allies/enemies after using two Support or Dancer abilities if the triggering ability is Support/Dancer

description.name: Troupe Mayakov Mode (Celerity)
description.text: Grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all allies after using Celerity abilities
